name: side_type
evidence: map::BattleInfo::Side::CalculateDetail 0x00348788 and CalculateDetailAttack compare this byte of the other side with 2 and 3 (a follow-up side)

name: unit
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateDual 0x003473D0 and BattleCalculator::CalculateAttackSingle read the side's unit here

name: item
evidence: the side's weapon, a unit::Item (4 bytes; this is its item number): map::BattleInfo::CalculateDetail 0x00347A58 tests it for 0 and passes side + 0x10 to unit::Item::ToData; Side::CalculateDetailHit/Attack pass it to Unit::GetHit/GetAttack

name: triangle
evidence: weapon triangle factor of this side against the opposing lead: map::BattleInfo::CalculateDetail 0x00347AB0 stores the WeaponInteract matrix cell (+1, -1 or 0), 0x00347B68 multiplies it by -2 when exactly one of the two sides has a reversing weapon; Side::CalculateDetailHit 0x00349130 / CalculateDetailAttack 0x00349A68 scale the rank bonus with it

name: flags
evidence: map::BattleInfo::ComplementConditions 0x00348000: side 0 gets bit 0, side 2 bits 0 and 1, side 3 bit 1 (bit 1 = a follow-up side; GetSimplePower 0x005259B8 halves its damage); CalculateDual tests 0x40 (side 0), 0x100 and 0x4000

name: power
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateSimple 0x00347CD8 stores Side::GetSimplePower (the damage of one strike) here

name: hit_rate
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateSimple 0x00347CE8 stores Side::GetSimpleHit (the shown hit) here

name: crit_rate
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateSimple 0x00347DDC stores the shown critical (own critical - other side's critical avoid, 0 .. 100) here

name: crit_factor
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateSimple 0x00347EE8 stores 300 (400 with one item flag, halved with one skill bit of the other side): the critical damage factor in percent

name: attack_count
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateDual 0x00347428 reads it on a main side and stores 0 into the follow-up side's (side + 2) when no follow-up strikes

name: guard_breaker
evidence: map::BattleCalculator::CalculateAttackSingle 0x0036376C: on the defending side, a strike from a follow-up side is blocked whatever the gauge, and that block does not empty the gauge (0x00364538); what sets it not traced

name: detail
evidence: the side's numbers against a lead (row 0) and against a follower (row 1): Side::CalculateDetail 0x003487A8 and CalculateDetailHit/Avoid/Attack/Defense address side + 0x48 + 0x24 * (other side is type 2 or 3); GetSimpleHit 0x00525258 reads row 0's hit at +0x5C

name: dual_unit
evidence: map::BattleInfo::ComplementDual 0x003474A0 fills it from map::BattleDualUnitEnumerator (an adjacent ally) or keeps the pair partner; CalculateDual 0x003473BC

name: dual_attack
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateDual 0x003473C0 clears it and sets 1 when the side's follow-up may strike

name: gauge_total
evidence: map::BattleInfo::CalculateDual 0x00347400 stores lead.guard_gauge + partner.guard_gauge

name: skill_hit
evidence: added to the hit by Side::CalculateDetailHit 0x00349198; written by map::EquipSkillCalculator::Calculate 0x0036EA60

name: skill_crit
evidence: added to the critical by Side::CalculateDetail 0x0034880C; written by map::EquipSkillCalculator::Calculate 0x0036EA98

name: skill_avoid
evidence: added to the avoid by Side::CalculateDetailAvoid 0x0034936C; written by map::EquipSkillCalculator::Calculate 0x0036EAD0

name: skill_crit_avoid
evidence: added to the critical avoid by Side::CalculateDetail 0x003488A0; written by map::EquipSkillCalculator::CalculateAround 0x0036C320

name: skill_bits
evidence: a bit set of skill numbers: Side::GetSimpleTimes 0x00525B9C, GetSimplePower and CalculateEfficacy test byte (id >> 3) bit (id & 7); for the other side's row 1 they add 0x94; the length is a guess (no bound found)

name: bonus_crit
evidence: added to the critical by Side::CalculateDetail 0x003487FC (who writes it: not traced)

name: bonus_crit_avoid
evidence: added to the critical avoid by Side::CalculateDetail 0x00348894 (row 1: + 0x94); who writes it: not traced

name: bonus_attack_speed
evidence: added to Unit::GetContinuous by Side::CalculateDetail 0x00348930

name: bonus_defense_speed
evidence: added to Unit::GetUnderContinuous by Side::CalculateDetail 0x0034898C

name: extra_crit
evidence: added to the critical by Side::CalculateDetail 0x00348818 (who writes it: not traced)

name: extra_crit_avoid
evidence: added to the critical avoid by Side::CalculateDetail 0x003488AC (who writes it: not traced)
